specs.title: A real wrong Spotter answer returns from a reloaded structure study with its round, navigation and newer notes intact
A paused unanswered Spotter permits normal Explore names and canvas selection, then resumes the same unanswered round
Study and return effects respect deliberate focus, and a superseded round cannot use its saved study origin
Spotter explains cumulative answer counts and separates the chosen function from the marked structure
